data.content_ref: inline:SRC_010's bounded-integer weighted operator reduces to SRC_006's threshold-τ labeling: the least fixed point of the weighted operator on the finite lattice of (label, weight) pairs equals the family of grounded labelings obtained by scanning SRC_006's threshold from τ=0 upward, so the weighted fixpoint is an abstraction of the threshold sweep. Refuted if there exists a weighted attack graph whose least fixed point differs from every threshold-τ grounded labeling of SRC_006.
